summary.text: Chad Aull is a Democratic state representative from Kentucky House District 79 who has served since 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He has worked as an IT manager.

paragraphs.text: Chad Aull earned a B.S. from Western Kentucky University.
His career experience includes working as an IT manager with Live Person.
He served as treasurer of the Morton Middle School Parent Teacher Student Association and on the board of the Bluegrass Rape Crisis Center.
Aull took office in the Kentucky House on January 1, 2023, succeeding Susan Westrom.
In the 2025-2026 session he was assigned to the Agriculture Committee, the Banking and Insurance Committee, and the Licensing, Occupations, and Administrative Regulations Committee.
